messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up: Meridian Health is asking for a reserved commit. Need quick alignment on sizing, preheat, and security Qs.

raj_sre: What did presales assume for rps and avg tokens?

nina_sales: Quote used 40 rps peak, 25 rps baseline, ~110 tokens per call. Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q. Commit quoted: 15M tokens/month.

marc_infra: Peak token rate = 40*110 = 4400 tps -> ~380M/day if sustained. 15M/month is much lower. We'll propose two contract options: steady-reserve for baseline, and reserve+burst for peaks.

eva_fin: Agreed. I draft two pricing scenarios: (1) reserve sized for baseline w/ token overage; (2) larger reserve sized to cover peaks w/ discounted burst credits.

olga_prod: Need to call out KV-cache warmup for multi-turn chat. Suggest 4h preheat as default, note cold-miss risk if less.

raj_sre: Autoscale proposal (sample snippet):
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas_reserved: 8
  scale_step: 1
  cooldown: 60s
  burst_pool: hosted-burst
```

marc_infra: I'll run perf sims on H100/A100 tomorrow and post a small table mapping rps->GPUs for the quantized model. Include preheat GPU-hours estimate.

nina_sales: Customer asked about BYOK and VPC.

marc_infra: BYOK supported for Private/Dedicated. Integration needs key policy and ~48-72h lead time. VPC/private endpoint supported; ops needs peering window.

ci-bot: scheduled job "meridian-preheat-smoke" for 2026-04-04T03:00:00Z. Notified: @marc_infra, @raj_sre.

eva_fin: Also list contract fallback: when reserved exhausted we spill to hosted-burst or degrade to smaller quantized model. Legal wants explicit latency delta in appendix.

olga_prod: I'll assemble a one-page runbook with sizing matrix, autoscale snippet, routing fallback, preheat guidance, and short security answers. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

nina_sales: Timeline: confirm customer's monthly vs peak numbers today. Marc posts perf sims in 48h. Eva to circulate pricing examples Monday. Raj to own smoke/KV test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
